facts.name: Laura Gao
facts.source: Wharton Global High School Investment Competition case study, Laura Gao.

policy.source: Cash Cows team strategy. Editable, and a change creates a new framework version.

A.name: Operating Liability Portfolio
A.purpose: Fund the ten $50,000 payments from 2033 to 2042.

B.name: Growth Portfolio
B.purpose: Grow capital before 2033 to raise what Laura can put toward the facility.

C.name: Flexibility / Residual Portfolio
C.purpose: Keep capital beyond the residency so one project does not absorb everything.

CG.label: Core Growth
CG.description: The spine of the growth sleeve. Broad, diversified, held for the whole run to 2033.

SG.label: Satellite Growth
SG.description: A researched individual position taken on top of the core, sized small on purpose.

ID.label: International Diversifier
ID.description: Exposure outside the United States, held to reduce single-country dependence.

LM.label: Liability Matcher
LM.description: Dedicated to a specific $50,000 payment year. Certainty matters more than yield.

LR.label: Liquidity Reserve
LR.description: Short-dated and liquid. Covers timing, not growth.

LG.label: Long-Term Residual Growth
LG.description: Capital intended to stay invested after 2033 once the residency is funded.

DA.label: Defensive Allocation
DA.description: Ballast. Expected to behave differently from equities in a drawdown.
